qualification.education_qualification: Advocates practising law in district Pilibhit (advocate registration and COP certificate to be enclosed)

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format (Aavedan Patra ka Prarup) printed with the order.
Name the post applied for and the district headquarters or tehsil chosen for service on the form.
Paste a self-attested passport size colour photograph and enclose a self-attested photocopy of the advocate registration certificate and COP certificate.
Get the application forwarded by the President or Secretary of the concerned Bar Association.
Submit the application to the Administrative Section, District Court, Pilibhit by office hours on 20-11-2026.
important_instructions: Form asks for details of service as Oath/General/Survey/Evidence/Accounts Commissioner in the last five years or any other government service Form asks for income tax filed last year, only if the applicant is a taxpayer Mobile number on the form is mandatory Order was circulated among tehsil Bar Associations through the Sub-Divisional Magistrates

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Pilibhit District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Pilibhit District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application format on page 2 of the order) and send it to Administrative Section, District Court, Pilibhit, by submitted at the administrative section by office hours, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Pilibhit District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Advocates practising law in district Pilibhit (advocate registration and COP certificate to be enclosed). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q4. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only advocates practising law in district Pilibhit may apply. Form asks for details of any office of profit held now and consent to resign from it if selected.
